# Seenn

> Seenn is an AI accounts-receivable agent for small and mid-sized businesses. Its AI coworker, Shira, contacts overdue clients by phone, WhatsApp, and email, follows your payment rules, handles disputes, records outcomes, and gets you paid faster — without adding staff. Serving the United States and Israel. Hebrew site at /he/.

Seenn is an approved Meta Tech Provider for WhatsApp Business. Getting started takes minutes: connect your accounting system (ready-made integrations with Priority, SAP, Hashavshevet and iCount/Rivhit; Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, QuickBooks, Xero and others connected on request; custom integrations or API for enterprise) or upload an Excel export from any system, connect a phone/WhatsApp number, set your collection rules and escalation timing, and Shira starts contacting overdue clients automatically. Every interaction is logged to your dashboard.

## Product
- [Seenn — AI Accounts Receivable Agent (home)](https://www.seenn.ai/): what Seenn is and how the AI agent Shira collects overdue invoices automatically

- [WhatsApp Payment Reminders](https://www.seenn.ai/whatsapp-reminders.html): WhatsApp payment reminders that collect, not just remind — backed by real phone calls
- [Accounting & ERP Integrations](https://www.seenn.ai/integrations.html): the three ways to connect — ready-made integrations, integrations on request (Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, QuickBooks, Xero and more), or Excel upload from any system

## Comparisons
- [Seenn vs HighRadius](https://www.seenn.ai/alternatives/highradius.html): HighRadius is a full office-of-the-CFO suite for large enterprises; Seenn is a collections-only AI agent for smaller finance teams that places the calls itself
- [Seenn vs Chaser](https://www.seenn.ai/alternatives/chaser.html): both automate email and voice calls; Seenn adds official WhatsApp Business messaging, a Hebrew-speaking agent, and Priority/Hashavshevet integrations
- [Seenn vs Upflow](https://www.seenn.ai/alternatives/upflow.html): Upflow is a financial relationship management platform; Seenn is an AI agent that phones overdue clients and follows up on WhatsApp and email

## Key facts
- Product: AI accounts-receivable / collections agent (the AI agent is named Shira)
- Channels: three — phone (natural voice), WhatsApp, email
- WhatsApp: official WhatsApp Business API — Seenn is an approved Meta Tech Provider, so messages come from a verified business number. Every reminder carries a payment link for the client's exact outstanding balance, and Shira reads and answers incoming replies.
- Capabilities: automated reminders, payment links, dispute handling, outcome logging, custom escalation rules, AR aging and collections reporting
- AR data and reporting: dashboard with total receivables and overdue amounts, aging by day ranges or by month (matching each customer’s own data), amounts falling due in the coming months, collections by month, refusals flagged, and every call, message, promise to pay and dispute logged
- Learning: Shira learns each client’s own customers’ payment behavior to collect better for that client only; the data is never shared or used for anyone else
- Integrations: ready-made integrations with Priority, SAP, Hashavshevet and iCount/Rivhit; Oracle (NetSuite, Fusion Cloud ERP), Microsoft Dynamics 365, Sage, Odoo, QuickBooks, Xero and others connected on request; Excel upload from any system; custom integrations and API for enterprise
- Markets: United States, Israel
- Languages: English (https://www.seenn.ai/), Hebrew (https://www.seenn.ai/he/)
- Contact: hello@seenn.ai · phone and WhatsApp (Israel): +972-55-931-1784
